name: flash-cycle-and-selected-screen-off
source:
Flash 1,"(f00,1)(0f0,2)"
Wait 1
Print Colour(1)
Wait 1
Print Colour(1)
Flash Off
Wait 3
Print Colour(1)

encoding.notes: Literal original Flash=0d44, Flash Off=0d34, Wait=129e, Print=0476 and Colour query=0d2c words; physical-line framing assembled independently of production encoders/tables.

evidence.notes: The first step is due at the next VBL; its duration schedules the next colour. Flash Off removes current-screen entries while retaining palette values. Source analysis, not an Amiga execution capture.
